title: Head of Creative, Marketing (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Creative, Marketing (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Memberikan arahan kreatif secara menyeluruh untuk seluruh organisasi.

Bertanggung jawab atas keseluruhan ekuitas merek (brand equity) SawitPRO, termasuk positioning di pasar.

Bertanggung jawab atas positioning produk dan merek untuk seluruh produk dan layanan SawitPRO.

Memimpin dan mengelola strategi konten untuk proyek berskala kecil maupun besar, termasuk membuat pedoman dan template untuk desain merek, copywriting, visual, dan aset digital.

Melakukan audit terhadap seluruh hasil karya kreatif dari berbagai tim serta memberikan saran perbaikan untuk meningkatkan keterlibatan dan pengalaman pengguna.

Berpartisipasi dalam seluruh sesi kreatif dan brainstorming dari berbagai tim untuk memberikan ide-ide baru dan inovatif dalam pengembangan produk, peluncuran kampanye pemasaran, serta operasional bisnis.

Mengembangkan pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai persona pelanggan sasaran dan berperan sebagai konsultan internal dalam menentukan pendekatan yang efektif maupun yang kurang efektif bagi pengguna.

Mengajarkan tim untuk mendorong batas kreativitas meskipun dengan keterbatasan anggaran dan waktu.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Kreativitas Pemasaran - Mengawasi, membimbing, dan mengarahkan hasil kreatif dari seluruh kampanye pemasaran SawitPRO, baik secara online maupun offline.

Kreativitas Desain Produk - Melakukan audit dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan terhadap desain produk yang dikembangkan oleh tim Product Management.

Tim Loyalty Management - Membantu dalam proses ideasi, pembuatan, dan perancangan konsep-konsep baru yang inovatif untuk mendorong pertumbuhan program loyalitas.

Tim Customer Experience - Bekerja sama dengan tim eCommerce dan Sales untuk menciptakan ide-ide kreatif yang dapat meningkatkan penjualan produk eCommerce maupun produk offline. Meningkatkan keterlibatan dan loyalitas pelanggan.

Kreativitas Operasional - Bekerja sama dengan tim operasional untuk merancang dan menghasilkan cara-cara kreatif dalam menjalankan operasional bisnis, mulai dari pengelolaan kantor, pengumpulan umpan balik pengguna, pengiriman produk, hingga penyelenggaraan webinar bagi pengguna.

Mengawasi tim lintas fungsi yang terdiri dari Graphic Designer, Copywriter, Social Media Specialist, Photographer/Videographer, dan Product Manager dalam pengembangan strategi komunikasi serta hasil kerja yang akan disampaikan.

Menyelenggarakan sesi brainstorming bersama tim kreatif dengan tetap menerapkan pemikiran strategis untuk menghasilkan inisiatif yang inovatif, dapat diterapkan, dan tetap mempertimbangkan efisiensi anggaran.

Menunjukkan kepemimpinan dan kemampuan manajemen tim yang memadai dalam mendorong pelaksanaan ide-ide kreatif di dalam tim kreatif.

Kualifikasi

Pendidikan

Gelar Sarjana (S1) di bidang Computer Graphics, Game Design, Graphic Design, Industrial Design, Product Design, Interior Design, atau bidang seni kreatif lainnya.

Pengalaman

Minimal 10 tahun pengalaman bekerja sebagai Copywriter, Graphic Designer, Production Artist, Game Designer, Sketch Artist, Interior Designer, atau bidang kreatif terkait.

Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengembangkan model bisnis yang inovatif serta mengembangkan saluran bisnis, model bisnis, atau transformasi bisnis.

Memiliki pengalaman di industri yang berorientasi pada konsumen seperti Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), perbankan konsumen, asuransi digital, FinTech, sharing economy, dan sejenisnya menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan desain kreatif mulai dari tahap ide hingga implementasi.

Memiliki pengetahuan tentang industri kelapa sawit menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai berbagai saluran komunikasi, pemasaran, dan periklanan, baik online maupun offline.

Memiliki pengalaman yang terbukti dalam mengelola tim, stakeholder, serta mengawasi proyek desain berskala besar.

Pengetahuan/Keterampilan

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai perilaku, motivasi, dan karakteristik manusia.

Memiliki kemampuan kreativitas visual dan desain grafis yang sangat baik, serta memahami penggunaan warna, tipografi, tata letak, bahasa, persepsi manusia, dan elemen desain lainnya.

Memiliki pemahaman bisnis yang kuat, termasuk pengetahuan spesifik mengenai industri manufaktur, perusahaan berbasis sumber daya alam, serta unit bisnisnya.

Memiliki kemampuan berpikir kreatif, analitis, strategis, konseptual, serta keterampilan konsultasi yang sangat baik.

Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang sangat baik, termasuk kemampuan menjelaskan konsep serta teknologi digital kepada para pemimpin bisnis, maupun menjelaskan konsep bisnis kepada berbagai pihak.

Memiliki semangat yang tinggi, idealisme yang kuat, serta visi untuk berkontribusi dalam mewujudkan masa depan Indonesia yang lebih baik.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah perusahaan inovatif yang berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. SawitPRO mengembangkan platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), yang menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis. Misi kami adalah meningkatkan kesejahteraan pekebun kelapa sawit swadaya di Indonesia, membuka peluang nilai tambah bagi industri, serta mendorong daya saing di pasar global melalui penerapan ketertelusuran (traceability) dan keberlanjutan produk kelapa sawit.

Kami menyediakan platform yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), agen, pekebun swadaya, dan penyedia sarana produksi pertanian. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang menghilangkan hambatan dalam proses bisnis serta meningkatkan produktivitas pekebun melalui akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian berkualitas dengan harga terjangkau, layanan agronomi, dan benih unggul berkualitas tinggi.

Kami memiliki visi untuk menjadi penggerak perubahan yang mampu meningkatkan taraf hidup pekebun swadaya sekaligus membantu mewujudkan pemenuhan kebutuhan global akan minyak sawit berkelanjutan.

Daftar Sekarang

title: E-Commerce Executive (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

E-Commerce Executive (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Primary Responsibilities

Own, lead and drive the eCommerce business of SawitPRO called Toko Sawit

To drive the online demand for goods and services sold by SawitPRO

Work with different departments to ensure a comprehensive eCommerce strategy for capturing market share, market development and sales of toko Sawit

Ensure high adoption of Toko Sawit

Define the SLAs for Toko Sawit online business

Work closely with operations team to ensure on-time fulfillment of online orders

Own P&L responsibility of Toko Sawit constantly driving towards higher revenues and profits

Role of the eCommerce Executive

eCommerce Strategy

- Develop, own and constantly update end to end eCommerce business strategy for Toko Sawit through innovation and creativity

Customer Experience Management

- Ensure highest standards of online shopping experience for Toko Sawit customers

Category Management

- Ensure the most sought after products are always listed in the product catalog of Toko Sawit. Continuously source for high revenue, high profit products to be listed on Toko Sawit

Revenue Management

- Come up with innovative pricing strategies for products to optimise revenues while serving the

best price guarantee

of SawitPRO

Sales Growth

- Maximise sales revenues for online sales through constant growth of customer base, product catalog, best pricing and customer satisfaction

User adoption

- Ensure high levels of recurring revenue from the existing users, referral business and other strategies for highest standards of user adoption

Promotions and marketing

- Work with marketing team to launch innovative online marketing campaigns and promotions for building the SawitPRO and Toko Sawit brands

Partnerships

-

Collaborate with partnership team to maximise online to offline (O2O) sales, revenues and profits

Performance monitoring

- Constantly monitor Toko Sawit performance to ensure maximum availability of Toko Sawit products. Close inventory monitoring with the operations team to maximize product availability across all regions

eCommerce Loyalty

- Develop loyalty programs for online shopping

Execution KPIs

– clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organization

P & L

- Manage revenue and costs generated from the online user base

Kualifikasi

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business or Marketing discipline is required.

Experience

Min. 2 years’ experience working in eCommerce business, preferably with some independent P&L responsibilities

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Palm oil industry knowledge would be helpful

title: Event Organizer (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Event Organizer (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Summary

:

The Event Marketing Coordinator plays a crucial role in the promotion and execution of events related to a digital loyalty platform specific to the Palm Oil Industry, with a focus on the Upstream and Midstream sectors. This role involves planning and coordinating various marketing activities, including trade shows, conferences, webinars, and industry networking events. The Event Marketing Coordinator works closely with cross-functional teams, industry partners, and stakeholders to ensure successful event experiences that drive engagement and enhance the platform's visibility in the market.

Responsibilities:

Event Planning and Execution: Plan, coordinate, and execute events aligned with the marketing strategy and objectives of the digital loyalty platform in the Palm Oil Industry. This includes identifying suitable events, managing event logistics, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring timely execution.

Event Marketing: Develop and implement event marketing campaigns to promote events and generate attendance. Utilize various channels, such as email marketing, social media, and industry publications, to maximize event visibility and attract target audiences.

Collateral and Content Development: Create event-related collateral, such as brochures, presentations, and promotional materials. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop compelling event content, including speaker profiles, session descriptions, and educational resources.

Industry Networking: Establish and maintain relationships with industry associations, organizations, and influencers. Actively participate in industry networking events and build strategic partnerships to expand the platform's reach and enhance its industry presence.

Event Analysis and Reporting: Measure and evaluate event performance through post-event analysis. Analyze metrics, such as attendance, lead generation, and attendee feedback, to assess event success and provide insights for future event planning and optimization.

Budget Management: Develop event budgets, track expenses, and ensure adherence to allocated budgets. Negotiate contracts and agreements with vendors, venues, and service providers to maximize cost-effectiveness.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with the marketing team, sales team, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure event strategies align with overall marketing and business goals. Coordinate with internal teams to secure speaker participation, organize product demonstrations, and provide event support.

Project Management: Effectively manage multiple event projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines, deliverables, and budgets are met. Employ project management methodologies to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall event experiences.

Kualifikasi

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in event management are a plus.

Experience: 3-5 years of experience in event planning, event marketing, or related roles. Experience in organizing and executing events within the Palm Oil Industry or a similar industry is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Palm Oil Industry, specifically the Upstream and Midstream sectors. Familiarity with industry events, trade shows, conferences, and key stakeholders is preferred.

Event Management: Demonstrated experience in event planning, logistics management, and execution. Proven ability to handle multiple events simultaneously, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.

Marketing and Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling event content and effectively communicate event details to diverse audiences. Proficiency in social media marketing and email marketing is desirable.

Relationship Building: Strong networking and relationship-building skills to engage with industry partners, vendors, and event participants. Ability to establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.

Analytical and Reporting Abilities: Proficiency in analyzing event data, generating reports, and extracting actionable insights. Strong attention to detail in tracking event metrics and measuring event success.

Budgeting and Financial Management: Experience in event budget development, expense tracking, and contract negotiation. Ability to manage budgets effectively and maximize cost-efficiency.

Creativity and Problem-Solving: Innovative thinking and problem-solving skills to overcome challenges, identify opportunities, and enhance event experiences. Ability to think strategically and deliver unique event concepts.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to adapt plans and strategies based on changing priorities and emerging industry trends.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

SawitPRO is a game-changer, improving the smallholders’ living standard and helping our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil through efficient land use.

Daftar Sekarang

title: Senior Product Designer (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Senior Product Designer (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead the end to end design process: research, discovery, problem framing, flows, prototyping, UI, handover and post-launch interaction

Conduct field research in plantations, collection points, and mills (interviews, shadowing, usability tests) and turn findings into clear product direction

Mentor junior designers through design critiques, feedback sessions

Contribute to and apply the design system suited to field-facing products

Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, stakeholders and other teams to define scope, trade-offs, and success metrics

Kualifikasi

5+ years of product design experience

Confident & comfortable in conducting user research and usability testing independently

Proficiency in design tool like Figma, Google Suite and other AI tools

Showcase a portfolio of real project or case study with process: research, problem definition, interaction design with measurable outcomes

Excellent communication skills in Indonesian and English, with the ability to present and defend design decisions to stakeholders

Willingness to travel to plantations and rural areas for field research

Background from agritech or agriculture is a plus

Based or agreed to be located in Pekanbaru

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

Daftar Sekarang

title: Odoo Functional - GSI
raw_description:
Lowongan pekerjaan ini dipublikasikan melalui akun PT Global Service Indonesia. Kandidat terpilih akan menjadi karyawan PT Global Service Indonesia dengan penempatan di United Tractors Group (UT Group).

  1. Melakukan analisis kebutuhan bisnis pengguna, khususnya pada proses akuntansi dan keuangan, untuk diterapkan ke dalam sistem Odoo ERP.
  2. Melakukan konfigurasi dan implementasi modul Odoo Accounting, termasuk pengaturan Chart of Accounts, jurnal, pajak, vendor bills, customer invoices, pembayaran, dan rekonsiliasi bank.
  3. Mengumpulkan dan mendokumentasikan kebutuhan pengguna melalui proses requirement gathering, penyusunan Business Requirement Document (BRD), serta pemetaan proses bisnis (business process mapping).
  4. Melakukan pengujian sistem (functional testing dan UAT) untuk memastikan konfigurasi Odoo sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis.
  5. Memberikan pelatihan dan pendampingan kepada pengguna terkait penggunaan modul Accounting pada Odoo.
  6. Melakukan identifikasi masalah, analisis kendala, serta koordinasi dengan tim teknis untuk penyelesaian permasalahan sistem.
  7. Menyusun dokumentasi konfigurasi, panduan penggunaan, dan laporan implementasi sistem.
  8. Memberikan dukungan pascaimplementasi serta melakukan evaluasi untuk meningkatkan efektivitas proses akuntansi menggunakan Odoo.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Informatika, atau bidang lain yang relevan.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Odoo Functional Consultant, Odoo Functional, ERP Functional Consultant, atau posisi sejenis.
  3. Memahami proses bisnis akuntansi dan keuangan, seperti General Ledger, Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), jurnal umum, perpajakan, dan rekonsiliasi bank.
  4. Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan dan melakukan konfigurasi Odoo ERP, khususnya modul Accounting.
  5. Memahami proses implementasi ERP, mulai dari requirement gathering, analisis kebutuhan, konfigurasi sistem, functional testing, UAT, hingga user training.
  6. Mampu menyusun dokumentasi kebutuhan bisnis, functional specification, test scenario, dan user manual.
  7. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, pemecahan masalah, komunikasi, dan koordinasi yang baik dengan pengguna maupun tim teknis.
  8. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim serta berorientasi pada penyelesaian masalah dan kebutuhan pengguna.

title: Business Development Analyst - MODA
raw_description:
1. Melakukan analisis pasar, industri, dan pesaing untuk mengidentifikasi industri baru yang potensial serta mengeksplorasi inisiatif pengembangan bisnis baru (termasuk model masuk yang diutamakan).
  2. Menyusun laporan analitis dan rekomendasi untuk Atasan & Manajemen.
  3. Memberikan masukan mengenai tren pasar, pergerakan pesaing, dan peluang bisnis yang muncul guna mendukung proses perencanaan strategis perusahaan.
  4. Menjelajahi dan mengevaluasi model bisnis yang ada melalui analisis biaya dan manfaat.
  5. Menganalisis dan mengevaluasi kelayakan kemitraan yang ada.
  6. Mengidentifikasi mitra potensial yang selaras dengan strategi bisnis MODA.
  7. Menilai kesesuaian mitra berdasarkan kemampuan, posisi pasar, kondisi keuangan, dan keselarasan strategis.
  8. Mengkoordinasikan pendekatan awal, pengaturan pertemuan, dan komunikasi dengan mitra potensial.
  9. Menyusun materi promosi, proposal, dan presentasi untuk diskusi dengan mitra.
  10. Membangun dan memelihara hubungan dengan mitra eksternal utama, klien, dan pemangku kepentingan strategis.
  11. Mendukung keterlibatan tingkat eksekutif, negosiasi, dan diskusi kemitraan.
  12. Mengumpulkan dan memvalidasi informasi keuangan, hukum, teknis, dan operasional dari mitra potensial.

title: Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Mengidentifikasi dan mendapatkan prospek (lead) baru serta membangun basis pelanggan yang berkelanjutan.

Mengembangkan dan mengelola pipeline prospek untuk secara konsisten mencapai target bulanan.

Secara proaktif mencari prospek baru melalui berbagai strategi pendekatan langsung.

Mengelola seluruh proses penjualan, mulai dari kontak awal dengan prospek hingga proses penutupan penjualan.

Membangun dan menjaga hubungan yang baik dengan prospek, serta memastikan keterlibatan mereka selama seluruh siklus penjualan.

Mendukung aktivitas yang berorientasi pada pencapaian pendapatan sesuai dengan Business Plan perusahaan.

Bekerja sama dengan tim internal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif.

Peran Sales Executive

Customer Service - Berfokus pada akuisisi dan retensi pelanggan melalui pendekatan layanan pelanggan yang berkualitas.

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pelanggan yang ada.

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang berkualitas melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan pengelolaan hubungan dengan pelanggan.

Kualifikasi

Gelar Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan (Sales) atau Business Development. Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman di industri agribisnis akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan peluang bisnis dengan hasil yang nyata.

Memiliki jaringan yang luas di industri kelapa sawit.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai industri kelapa sawit.

Mampu melakukan kegiatan canvassing dan wajib memiliki kendaraan pribadi.

Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris.

Bersedia ditempatkan di Pekanbaru

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah startup agritech digital hijau yang inovatif dengan kantor pusat di Jakarta. Misi kami adalah menjadi inovator terbaik yang mampu meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. Melalui platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), kami menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis.

Kami menyediakan aplikasi terintegrasi yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), Agen DO, Pekebun Swadaya, Pemanen, Pengemudi, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang mampu meningkatkan produktivitas melalui dokumentasi pekerjaan yang lebih mudah, akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian yang terjangkau dan terjamin keasliannya, serta layanan agronomis profesional.

Komitmen kami tidak hanya menghadirkan solusi yang inovatif, tetapi juga mendukung pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan industri kelapa sawit Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa melalui inovasi dan kolaborasi, kami dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi kehidupan setiap pelaku di industri kelapa sawit.

Daftar Sekarang

title: Dept Head of Business Development - MODA
raw_description:
1. Menentukan prioritas BD, target, dan strategi kemitraan yang selaras dengan tujuan perusahaan.
  2. Meninjau dan memvalidasi wawasan pasar, industri, dan pesaing untuk menjadi insights pemilihan peluang.
  3. Memberikan penilaian strategis mengenai model bisnis, struktur komersial, dan pendekatan pasar (peninjauan bisnis yang ada & peluang baru).
  4. Membangun dan memelihara hubungan dengan mitra eksternal utama, klien, dan pemangku kepentingan strategis.
  5. Memimpin keterlibatan tingkat eksekutif, negosiasi, dan diskusi kemitraan.
  6. Mewakili perusahaan dalam dialog strategis untuk memperkuat kolaborasi jangka panjang.
  7. Mengarahkan dan mengawasi semua proses BD untuk memastikan keselarasan, efisiensi, dan kualitas.
  8. Meninjau hasil uji tuntas, evaluasi mitra, dan analisis kelayakan keuangan/bisnis sebelum diserahkan kepada manajemen.
  9. Memberikan panduan mengenai strategi negosiasi, struktur kesepakatan, dan mitigasi risiko.
  10. Memastikan penyelesaian proyek BD tepat waktu dan kepatuhan terhadap persyaratan internal.
  11. Berkoordinasi dengan fungsi terkait untuk memastikan keselarasan dalam inisiatif BD.
  12. Menggabungkan masukan lintas fungsi dan menyampaikan rekomendasi kepada manajemen.

  3. Sertifikasi CFA merupakan nilai tambah.
  4. Kemampuan yang kuat dalam pemodelan keuangan, penilaian, dan analisis data.

title: Sales B2B Logistik Surabaya - MODA
raw_description:
1. Mengembangkan dan menjalankan strategi pipeline serta rencana akuisisi untuk layanan platform logistik transportasi dengan fokus utama pada industri otomotif.

2. Mengakuisisi pelanggan baru (hunting) serta memperluas portofolio shipper melalui kegiatan prospecting, lead generation, dan pengembangan bisnis.

3. Membangun, mengelola, dan menjaga hubungan bisnis jangka panjang dengan klien baru maupun existing (key accounts) guna memastikan kepuasan pelanggan dan repeat order.

4. Mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan memahami kebutuhan shipper, khususnya di sektor otomotif, untuk menawarkan solusi logistik yang sesuai dengan kapabilitas layanan perusahaan.

5. Menyiapkan, mengajukan, dan mengelola proses tender/penawaran (bidding) secara kolaboratif dengan tim internal (Finance, Operations, dan Product).

title: FFB Supervisor (Jambi)
raw_description:
< Kembali

FFB Supervisor (Jambi)

Daftar Sekarang

Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Memiliki dan mengembangkan hubungan pelanggan dengan pelanggan B2B SawitPRO - terutama pemasok pabrik kelapa sawit (Pabrik CPO) yang dikenal sebagai Agen DO atau FFB Suppliers.

Mendorong strategi komersial SawitPRO, dengan fokus pada growth pendapatan, perluasan pasar, dan kemitraan strategis

Mengembangkan dan melaksanakan strategi komersial komprehensif yang selaras dengan misi SawitPRO untuk meningkatkan hubungan dengan Pemasok TBS

Mengidentifikasi dan mengejar peluang bisnis dan kemitraan baru untuk memperluas jejak SawitPRO di antara Pemasok TBS di wilayah tersebut

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pengguna

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan berkualitas tinggi kepada pemasok TBS melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan manajemen hubungan

Mempelajari tingkat motivasi masing-masing pemangku kepentingan pabrik, titik kesulitan mereka, peluang bisnis dan prospek growth

Kolaborasi antar tim di seluruh produk, penjualan, operasi, sales, dan teknologi untuk meningkatkan pemahaman yang baik tentang pelanggan

Menjaga komunikasi yang efektif dengan Pemasok TBS untuk memastikan kebutuhan mereka terpenuhi dan masalah apa pun yang mungkin timbul dapat diatasi. Memastikan Pemasok dikelola secara efisien, dengan fokus pada pencapaian target keuangan dan bisnis

Membantu waktu riset pelanggan dengan pengembangan dan implementasi strategi klien, termasuk riset pasar, riset pesaing, dll.

Membantu tim pemasaran dengan identifikasi audiens target, perencanaan dan pelaksanaan kampanye.

Memastikan semua data dan informasi klien akurat dan terkini, serta semua laporan klien disiapkan dan diterima tepat waktu.

Kualifikasi

Pendidikan minimal S1 dari semua Jurusan

Minimal pengalaman 5 tahun bekerja di bidang manajemen bisnis, customer service, growth, sales, dll.

Pengalaman di bidang kelapa sawit (FFB Purchase) diutamakan

Bersedia untuk melakukan perjalanan dinas di luar kota

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

Berikan manajemen wawasan yang akurat dan dapat diandalkan dengan menggunakan bukti dan data yang konkret.

Mengembangkan saluran pendapatan baru dalam bisnis FFB untuk mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis.

Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik dan pengalaman dalam bekerja dengan orang-orang di semua tingkatan.

Tingkat integritas dan akuntabilitas yang tinggi

Kemampuan untuk mempertahankan gambaran keseluruhan dan melihat gambaran besarnya.

title: Prime Natuna EP - Drilling & Wells Support Specialist
raw_description:
Responsible for planning, coordinating, and administering all drilling-related procurement, contracting, formalities, regulatory, orders and administrative activities required to support the successful execution of the Development Project drilling campaign. The role ensures timely readiness of drilling operations through effective Contract Management, Procurement Execution, Permit Processing, Regulatory Compliance, Stakeholder coordination, and Operational Support while maintaining compliance with PTK 007, SKK Migas requirements, and Company policies.

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

  • Drilling Contract & Procurement Support - Ensure timely procurement and contracting activities to support drilling readiness
  • Regulatory Compliance & Permitting - Ensure all drilling-related permits and regulatory requirements are completed on time
  • Operational Readiness & Stakeholder Coordination - Support preparedness of offshore drilling operations and cross-functional alignment
  • Documentation & Reporting - Maintain accurate and auditable drilling support records
  • Drilling & Well Services Material Asset Management - Ensure proper control, tracking, and disposition of drilling and well services materials/assets in the absence of a dedicated Drilling Material Specialist
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

  • ​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Petroleum Engineering, or related discipline. 
  • ​Min. 10 years working experience in Drilling Support, Contract Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, or Operations Support within the Oil and Gas industry​.
  • Experience managing Procurement and Contracting processes for Drilling Operations.
  • Experience preparing and Administering Contracts, Purchase Orders, Service Agreements, and Bid Evaluations.
  • Proven Experience coordinating multiple Stakeholders across Technical and Commercial functions.
  • Experience supporting Offshore Drilling Campaigns.
  • Experience working with SKK Migas and Indonesian Government Authorities.
  • Experience in Logistics Coordination and Operational readiness for Offshore Operations.
  • Experience in Natuna or similar Offshore Development Projects.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with proficiency in MS Office and relevant electrical engineering tools/software.

 

Special Skills / Knowledge:

  • Procurement & Contract Management
  • PTK 007 Compliance Knowledge
  • Tendering and Bid Evaluation
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Planning & Coordination
  • Regulatory & Permit Management
  • Commercial Negotiation
  • JDE Oracle / SAP Proficiency
  • Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint & Word
  • Offshore Drilling Operations Knowledge
  • Project Management
  • Logistics & Supply Chain Coordination
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Risk Assessment & Mitigation

title: Prime Natuna EP - Floating Infrastructure Sr. Electrical Engineer
raw_description:
Responsible for designing Electrical System for FPSO Project Development and ensure its safe and optimum project delivery as well as reliable operation. 

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

  • ​​​Implement project requirements into Electrical design. 
  • ​Provide electrical load list, schematic diagrams, single line diagrams, cable schedules and MTO using Smart Plant Electrical. 
  • ​Perform power system studies (short circuit, coordination, motor starting, arc flash, harmonics) using ETAP. 
  • ​Perform Insulation coordination and transient study using PSCAD or EMTP software. 
  • ​Perform calculations for equipment sizing, UPS, cable sizing, lighting, grounding and heat tracing. 
  • ​Prepare specifications, data sheets, cable schedules and interface schedules. 
  • ​Produce material take-off and material requisition. 
  • ​Review Bids and Technical Evaluation. 
  • ​Design and checking of single lines, schematics and wiring diagrams, area classification, grounding, panel/cable schedules, equipment layout, cable layout, tray layout, lighting and installation details without supervision. 
  • ​Review and coordinate electrical 3D model with the other disciplines. 
  • ​Review and coordinate electrical 2D AutoCAD/ Micro-station drawings. 
  • ​Visit construction/plant sites and fabrication shops during design phase on as required basis. 
  • ​Ensure construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities for electrical systems are delivered safely as per company requirement. 
  • ​Develop electrical engineering report for Project Development Management in a timely manner 
  • ​Performs non-routine tasks and attends such meetings as directed from time to time by Project Development Sr. Manager as opportunity presents in order to meet Company objectives.  Ensures that all relevant managers and subordinates are kept informed of all major opportunities, developments, problems or potential problems, which will impact upon the Business.
  • Indonesian Nationality
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

  • ​​​​​​​​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. 
  • ​Min. 15 years working experience as an electrical engineer for offshore floating infrastructure within oil and gas industry, preferably experience in project stage. 
  • ​Experienced in electrical design using Smart Plant Electrical or other electrical design software. 
  • ​ Minimum 15 years of experience in electrical engineering within the oil & gas industry, with strong exposure to offshore floating infrastructure projects, particularly FPSO, preferably covering project development, FEED, detailed engineering, and execution phases.
  • Proven experience in electrical system design and engineering for offshore floating facilities, including preparation and review of electrical engineering deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Experience in electrical engineering software and power system studies, including SmartPlant Electrical, ETAP, PSCAD/EMTP, or equivalent engineering applications.
  • Experience in construction, fabrication, pre-commissioning, and start-up support for electrical systems in offshore facilities is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with proficiency in MS Office and relevant electrical engineering tools/software.

Special Skills / Knowledge:

       • In-depth expertise in detailed engineering and design of electrical power systems for offshore floating facilities, particularly FPSO, covering power generation and distribution, electrical      equipment, cabling, grounding, lighting, UPS, and heat tracing systems.

      • Strong capability in electrical power system studies and analysis, including load flow/load assessment, short circuit, protection coordination, motor starting, arc flash, harmonics, insulation coordination, and transient studies using ETAP, PSCAD/EMTP, or equivalent tools.

      • Strong capability in developing and reviewing key electrical engineering deliverables, including load lists, single-line diagrams, schematics, equipment sizing calculations, cable schedules, equipment layouts, specifications, datasheets, material requisitions, and MTOs.

      • Comprehensive knowledge of international electrical codes, standards, and hazardous-area requirements applicable to offshore facilities, including ANSI, IEEE, IEC, NEC, NEMA, CSA, UL, API, and relevant area-classification requirements.

      • Strong multidisciplinary interface and constructability capability for FPSO electrical systems, including coordination with other engineering disciplines, 3D model reviews, vendor technical evaluations, and support during fabrication, construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up

title: bp - Kerja Praktek - Wells & HSE&C - Indonesia
raw_description:
We will not proceed any application from this job portal, please copy & paste bp's job link here:

https://bpinternational.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/bpEarlyCareers/job/Indonesia---Jakarta/Kerja-Praktek-Internship---Wells-and-HSE-C---Indonesia_RQ116673

About bp

As a leading global energy company with a presence in 61 countries, bp’s purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. We are one of only a few companies that can deliver energy – at scale – to countries and millions of customers every day. With more than 100 years of experience, we bring together technology, innovation and deep expertise that keeps communities moving – and we’re still evolving.

 

About early careers

Early careers opportunities

Your talent. Your skills. Your big ideas (and even bigger dreams). We know you have a lot to give. So we’ll make sure you get a lot in return. From next-level experiences to global impact. From inspiring teammates to exceptional support – we offer graduate and internship roles across multiple areas


Our internships

Make an impact on cutting-edge projects. Help find solutions to complex challenges. Be part of a company that invests in you and your growth. You can do it all as an intern at bp. Our 12-week programme gives you the opportunity to build your technical knowledge, develop key skills and learn more about life at bp. You'll be part of one team throughout your internship, supported by a dedicated line manager and buddy. There’ll be opportunities to connect with other interns, take part in training and grow your network across the business


Why join us?

You can make a real impact early in your bp career, contributing to large, complex projects on a global scale. There are many opportunities to learn here, whether through training, mentoring and stretch assignments or sharing knowledge with expert colleagues.

The diversity of our teams and business areas gives the option to develop your career in many different ways. We have a truly caring company culture, where your growth and wellbeing are supported every step of the way.

 

About the programme 

Kerja Praktek is an early career programme designed for upcoming 6th semester or 3rd-year university students to help students apply their academic knowledge in real-world settings and develop valuable career skills, while also fulfilling their academic credit requirements.


Available positions

Intern – wells

As a bp Wells Intern you’ll have a great opportunity to find out more about how hydrocarbon producing Wells are built and run by bp to deliver the energy the world needs. 
During your internship you’ll be a member of one of our onshore teams in one of the Drilling, Completions, Intervention or Integrity sub-disciplines, which look after how our Wells are designed, constructed, maintained and operated. As part of that team you’ll be expected to use your initiative, problem solving, collaborative and organisational skills under the guidance of an experienced engineer, to deliver the solution to a challenging project that addresses one of the issues that your team faces  


Intern – HSE & carbon 

The safety of our sites, the well-being of our people and our impact on the environment are fundamental to our business. Health, safety, environment, and carbon (HSE and carbon) cares for and protects our people and planet from harm. HSE and carbon covers all businesses throughout bp from offshore production facilities, to wind and solar farms, global networks of retail sites, and many other exciting ventures. Our ambition is to lead by example in partnering with everyone to deliver solutions that reduce risk and eliminate harm.     


 

Roles and responsibilities        

Kerja Praktek:

·       Assist with day-to-day operations and projects within the assigned department

·       Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas

·       Conduct research and prepare reports or presentations

·       Support administrative tasks and documentation

·       Learn and apply relevant tools and technologies


The precise nature of your role and task will be determined by your skills as well as the needs of the business but your responsibilities include:      

·       Working on task and supporting your squad to find the best solutions     

·       Helping to maintain performance within your squad and for bp as a company     

·       Building relationships within bp, collaborating across functions and squads to deliver excellence     

·       Demonstrating agility, initiative and dedication through the bp “Who we are”.    

During your internship you’ll get continuous feedback and guidance on how to plan and deliver your assigned project or task, along with advice on what to look for and who to talk to. You’ll also be encouraged, individually and together with your Intern peer group, to find out as much as possible about other teams, disciplines and operations to broaden your understanding of the bp business.
raw_requirements:
To be eligible for the internship programme you are:   

  • Be undertaking a relevant Bachelors (S1) or Masters (S2) degree in related roles, such as:

- Wells: petroleum engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, metallurgy engineering, material engineering, electrical engineering

- HSE&C: environmental engineering, process safety, HSE/K3, sustainable management, industrial engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial hygiene


  • Have a willingness to learn, a passion to excel and deliver results

  • Graduation criteria for eligibility for internship: graduating by August or November 2028 or will be penultimate year student (3rd year/ 6th semester) in January 2027

  • Internship is part of your academic requirements or it can be converted as academic credits

  • 1 application can only accommodate 1 person, and group applications are not allowed

Location    

You will be based in our Jakarta office.    

 

Document to submit along with your application 

- Resume/CV (Please include which role you are interested in)

- Academic transcript 

- (Only when you get selected) University endorsement letter: This letter must be printed on your university’s official letterhead, and it should confirm that the internship is a mandatory part of your academic program or bp internship can be considered as academic credit


You can combine all documents into one file. If you accidentally only upload 1 document, please do not withdraw your application and send us email for the remaining documents through the link contact us below or enquiryearlycareers@bp.com


Applications close on 30 November 2026.

 

Please note the following when applying:

·       You can only apply to 1 bp early careers opportunity globally per academic year – within this time, we will only process the first application you make, and you’ll be withdrawn from any subsequent applications.  

·       Please note that vacancies are filled on an ongoing basis after opening and we may close applications before any stated deadline. Therefore, we highly recommend you submit your application as early as possible to be considered for the opportunity of your choice.

title: PRIME Natuna EP - FIXED INFRASTRUTURE DELIVERY MANAGER
raw_description:
Responsible to deliver, lead and manage the Fixed Infrastructure elements of Development Projects. This responsibility and accountability specifically include for delivery of inputs from contributory functions and disciplines from Project select Gate to Commencement of the Production phase, ensuring that Fixed Infrastructure elements of development Projects are delivered in a safe, quality and environmentally conscious manner in line with Budget and Schedule commitments and other agreed project KPIs per phase of each project, all whilst ensuring maximum value is obtained for key B. Whilst the initial role is specific to the Tuna PSC Asset, the role shall also support the Long-term strategic view of potential Future Developments within the Business Unit portfolio, additionally supporting the Exploration function in the Identify Phase, proposing, costing, scheduling and evaluating development options, whilst offering innovative solutions to development challenges. 

This position is critically required at the Earliest Stage to ensure effective Leadership and Coordination for the preparation of Fixed Infrastructure FEED work. Early onboarding of a qualified Project Delivery Manager will safeguard Schedule Adherence, improve Technical and Commercial Evaluation Quality, and minimize risks associated with misalignment, rework, and cost escalation during the FEED and subsequent EPCI phases.
raw_requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Project Management. Preferably with a MSc in Engineering or Business Administration.

• Minimum 10 years experience in Managerial Role for Offshore Project Development.  

• Previous experience in delivering EPCI Contracts is a mandated requirement.

• Strong Collaborative Experience and Established Relationships with SKK Migas related division. 

• Experience in Upstream Oil and Gas operations, both Pre-Production and Production Sges is an advantage.

• Preference for Knowledge of SKKMigas Rules and Regulations inclusive of a working knowledge of PTK 007 Latest revision.

• Good knowledge in Subsurface, Drilling and Production functions and their relationship with Projects.

• Good Knowledge in Project Lifecycle from FEED through Construction, Installation and Commissioning.

• Experience with Managing the Key Interfaces between Fixed and Floating Infrastructure.

• Good knowledge in Project Lifecycle from FEED through Construction, Installation and Commissioning.

• Familiar with Project Schedule, Network Planning Structures and Techniques, including proficiency with Microsoft Project. Proficiency in utilisation of Primavera Project Planner (P6) is an advantage.

• Proficient with the use of Standard Office Software such as Visio, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

• Experience with Microsoft Access, Primavera Risk Analysis and Que$tor Tools is an advantage

• Fluent in English (written and spoken), with effective Communication Skills for Multidisciplinary Coordination and Stakeholder engagement

• Strong capability in Multidisciplinary Engineering integration for Offshore Fixed Infrastructure facilities, including in-depth understanding of Topsides, Jacket, Pipeline, Subsea, and key deliverables such as PFDs, P&IDs, HAZOP, and design basis across FEED and EPCI phases

• Advanced proficiency in Project Planning and control, covering scheduling, Cost Control, and progress monitoring, with working knowledge of tools such as Primavera P6 and MS Project

• Proven Leadership and Stakeholder Management Skills, with the ability to Lead Cross-functional and Multicultural Teams and effectively manage Clients, Contractors, Vendors, Shipyards, and JV Partners

• Strong expertise in Contract and Risk Management, including handling variations, Claims, Procurement Strategies, and proactive Risk Identification and Mitigation across the Project Lifecycle

• High commitment to HSE and Regulatory Compliance, with solid understanding of HAZID, HAZOP, SIL studies, and applicable Offshore and International standards

title: AVP-Fixed Voice Product & Service
raw_description:
Job Summary

The AVP-Fixed Voice Product Management is responsible for driving the strategy, development, lifecycle management, and commercialization of fixed voice services (e.g., SIP Trunking, Hosted PBX, PSTN replacement solutions) for enterprise and SME segments. This role ensures the product portfolio is competitive, scalable, and aligned with market demand, revenue targets, and operational efficiency goals.

Job Details

1.Product Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of fixed voice products, from launch to retirement.
  • Ensure product relevance through continuous market and customer feedback.
  • Maintain product documentation, feature catalogs, and change logs.

 

2.Operational Excellence

  • Oversee provisioning, activation, and service assurance processes.
  • Monitor SLA compliance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with network and infrastructure teams to ensure deployment readiness.

 

3.Performance & Quality Monitoring

  • Track product performance metrics (revenue achievement, product P&L, etc.)
  • Lead root cause analysis and resolution of recurring service issues.
  • Implement operational dashboards and reporting tools.

 

4.Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with sales, network, IT, and customer service teams.
  • Ensure alignment between product capabilities and delivery processes.
  • Support pre-sales and post-sales teams with product knowledge and operational insights.

 

5.Commercial Support

  • Provide input to pricing and bundling strategies based on operational feasibility.
  • Support GTM execution with operational readiness and service design.
  • Monitor product profitability and cost-to-serve metrics.

 

6.Team Leadership

  • Lead a lean team of product operations specialists and analysts.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, agility, and customer-centricity.
  • Develop team capabilities in lifecycle and operational management.

 

Minimum Requirements:

 

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree from a well-known university in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related STEM field.
  • Master’s degree (MBA or Technology Management) is preferred.
  • Professional certification in voice networking, marketing, or related field is a plus.
  • Recent formal and informal education in Artificial Intelligence and its applications is a plus.

 

Professional Experience:

  • 10-15 years of experience in product management, preferably in fixed voice, connectivity, or telecom solutions (e.g., SIP Trunk, Cloud PBX, LAN, WAN, etc.).
  • Experience in the telecom or ICT industry with exposure to enterprise/B2B markets.
  • Strong background in cross-functional collaboration (technology, sales, delivery, operations).
  • Proven experience leading product lifecycle (development, launch, enhancement, support).
  • Hands-on involvement in product PoC, technical support, and pre-sales activities.

 

Expected Skills

  • Technical & Commercial Understanding with solid grasp of voice network technologies (OSI Layer, fiber optic, SBC, Voice Firewall etc.) and enterprise connectivity solutions.
  • Product Management with ability to define roadmap, manage lifecycle, support sales, and ensure delivery excellence.
  • Analytical Thinking and Reporting with ability to monitor performance, revenue, project pipeline, and churn metrics effectively.

raw_description:
Requirements

Skills

  • Strong understanding of Telecom Core Networks (4G EPC, 5G Core, IMS, PCRF/PCF, charging, messaging).
  • Knowledge of AI/ML concepts, model lifecycle management, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture, microservices, APIs, and network-as-a-service concepts.
  • Experience with product lifecycle management, agile methodologies, and solution design.
  • Understanding of security, privacy, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Ability to translate technology capabilities into monetizable products.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field
  • 10+ years’ experience in telecom, product management, or technology leadership roles.
  • 5+ years’ experience working with AI/ML, analytics, or data-driven products.
  • 5+ years leading cross-functional teams and end-to-end product delivery.
  • Experience in 5G, cloud, APIs, network programmability, or digital platforms strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with multi-vendor Telco environments, open-source ecosystems, and hardware platform benchmarking
  • Strong analytical and architectural thinking,
  • Ability to communicate complex material to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Proactive leadership, vendor management, and decision-making.

 

Job Description

 

Key Responsibilities

Key Result Areas

Define the long-term strategy and roadmap for core network–enabled products and AI-driven services across consumer, enterprise, and wholesale segments.

A clear, actionable product strategy and multi-year roadmap.

Delivery of multi-year product & AI strategy

 

Translate market trends, customer insights, and technology evolution (5G, cloud, AI/ML, APIs) into differentiated product opportunities.

Development of competitive and market-aligned product propositions

 

Champion adoption of AI and analytics across network operations, customer experience, product design, and commercial teams.

AI embedded into key processes, products, and customer journeys

Lead product ideation, design, development, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.

On-time delivery of product features and AI services

 

Ensure performance, scalability, security, and compliance for all product and AI services.

Compliance with performance SLAs, security standards, and privacy regulations

Oversee governance frameworks for product delivery, including alignment with enterprise architecture, data governance, and AI ethics standards.

Strong governance across product lifecycle

 

Drive GTM strategies, pricing models, ecosystem partnerships, and channel enablement.

Effective pricing models and monetization strategies

 

Collaborate with marketing, sales, enterprise solutions, and customer success teams to ensure adoption and revenue growth.

Strong partner ecosystem resulting in measurable revenue contribution

 

Develop monetization frameworks for API-based services, network-as-a-service (NaaS), AI insights, and programmable network capabilities.

New monetizable AI-driven digital services

 

Ensure products comply with regulatory standards (data privacy, security, telecom regulations)

Responsible AI practices implemented and continuously assessed

 

Embed responsible AI principles—transparency, fairness, robustness—into AI-driven services

Reduced risk exposure across data, models, and services

Competency

Definition

Expected Behavio

Strategic Thinking

The ability to anticipate long-term trends, opportunities, and risks.

Ability to define long-term product and AI strategy.

The ability to inspire, drive, and deliver meaningful innovation.

The ability to communicate clearly, convincingly, and appropriately with stakeholders at all levels

Clear communicator with senior leadership and partners.

Change Leadership

Ability to drive organization-wide adoption of AI and new product capabilities.

title: Officer-Property Manager Sumapa
raw_description:
Role Purpose

This position is responsible for managing day-to-day property and building operations across Circle Sumapa. The role requires analytical thinking and effective communication with stakeholders in related with policy or any regulations that need to be implemented in the office area.

 

Scope of Work

Responsible for overseeing the daily operations, maintenance, and safety of a building or facility. This job scope includes:

1. Building Operations

  • Ensure the building is fully operational and meets safety, regulatory, and functional standards.
  • Oversee building systems, including AC, elevators, plumbing, electrical, and security systems.
  • Maintain a clean and hygienic environment.

2. Maintenance and Repairs

  • Schedule regular inspections and monitoring preventive maintenance for building equipment and infrastructure.
  • Coordinate and supervise contractors for repair or renovation work.
  • Address and resolve maintenance requests and issues promptly.
  • Monitoring MCP (Master Cleaning Program) from vendors

3. Occupant Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for employee occupants regarding complaints, requests, and inquiries.
  • Ensure employee satisfaction by resolving issues and maintaining a high standard of building amenities.
  • Facilitate tenant move-ins and move-outs, including inspection and documentation.

4. Safety and Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with local building codes, safety regulations, and environmental standards.
  • Conduct and coordinate regular fire drills, safety checks, and emergency preparedness exercises.
  • Manage security measures, including surveillance systems and access control.

5. Financial and Administrative Duties

  • Execute the building's operating budget approved.
  • Monitoring expenditures costs
  • Prepare reports on building operations expenses.

6. Vendor and Contractor Management

  • Manage service contracts for maintenance, cleaning, security, and landscaping.
  • Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with agreements.

7. Energy and Sustainability Initiatives

  • Monitoring energy-saving measures to maintain operational costs and environmental impact.

8. Crisis and Emergency Response

  • Act as a contact point between building occupants and the responsible teams to facilitate communication during emergencies, such as power outages, fires, and natural disasters.
  • Relay information between the responsible internal teams and external emergency services, including police, fire, and medical teams, as needed.

9. Space Management and Optimization

  • Oversee and manage office layouts, furniture arrangements, and common area utilization.

10. Communication and Reporting

  • Maintain open communication with stakeholders.
  • Provide and present regular updates and reports on building status, and issues.

Requirements

Qualification:

  • Bachelor degree, preferably from technical background (electrical, civil, mechanical engineering, etc)
  • Able to work under pressure.
  • Able to lead and collaborate effectively in a team.
  • Have good analytical sense and problem solver.

Related Experience:

Preferably 5 years of working experience in Property & Facilities Management

Management experience required

 

Skills:

  • Expertise in property and building management
  • Demonstrate good leadership and teamwork skills
  • Highly committed to quality and timely result of the work, including problem solving
  • Have good communication skills, to interact with vary stakeholders.

title: Head of Product FWA
raw_description:
Position Overview

 

The Vice President of Product Development & Go-to-Market Strategy is a senior executive leadership role responsible for driving the company's product innovation, market expansion, and revenue growth strategy. This position requires a visionary leader who will spearhead the development and commercialization of telecommunications products and services, with a strategic ambition to grow the subscriber base to 500,000 customers in 2 years of launch  while achieving and maintaining an Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) of USD $10

This role demands a strategic thinker with deep expertise in product lifecycle management, multi-channel go-to-market execution, customer journey optimization, and digital transformation within the telecommunications sector. The successful candidate will be instrumental in positioning the company as a competitive player in Indonesia's dynamic telco market.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Concept Creation: Lead ideation and conceptualization of innovative telecommunications products and service bundles targeting diverse customer segments (consumer, SME, enterprise)

Market Intelligence: Conduct continuous market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and customer insights gathering to identify white space opportunities and inform product development decisions

Portfolio Management:  Manage the entire product portfolio lifecycle from concept to sunset, ensuring optimal mix of revenue-generating products and strategic positioning

Product Innovation leading to growth:  Drive innovation initiatives leveraging emerging technologies (5G, IoT, digital services, fintech integration) to create differentiated value propositions

Business Case Development: Build comprehensive business cases including financial modelling, ROI projections, risk assessments, and resource requirements for new product initiatives

 

2. Product Development & Lifecycle Management

- End-to-End Product Development: Oversee agile product development processes from requirements gathering through launch, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Network, Finance, and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless product development and integration

- Quality Assurance: Establish product quality standards, testing protocols, and feedback mechanisms to ensure exceptional product performance and customer satisfaction

- Pricing Strategy: Develop dynamic pricing models and promotional strategies that balance competitiveness, customer value perception, and profitability targets

- Product Enhancement: Continuously optimize existing products based on performance analytics, customer feedback, and market dynamics to maximize lifetime value

title: Head of Sales (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Sales (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Primary Responsibilities

To oversee and integrate SawitPRO's Commercial, Marketing, Demand Planning, Customer Management, B2B sales, Growth, and Performance Measurement functions into a cohesive strategy. Oversee function:

Customer Experience to manage the following for the customers (primarily B2B)

Customer research, Customer acquisition, Customer engagement, Customer relationship management and Customer retention

Customer growth, including Growth Marketing through the development of a partner ecosystem, Customer Intelligence and Customers’ competitor Intelligence

Customer engagement events and marketing campaigns

Role of the Head of Sales:

Strategy & Ideation – The person responsible must develop the overall strategy and ideas behind the company's brand, as well as its customer and employee experiences.

Team management – Lead a team of collaborators and contributors for delivering on all aspects of the experience portfolio (XP)

Leadership – demonstrate leadership by coming up with innovative ideas to further the goals of the experience portfolio across all aspects of the organisation

Roadmap development – Develop the roadmap and budget for managing the experience portfolio by optimising the return on investment

Execution KPIs – clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organisation

Senior Management collaboration – work closely with senior management, including the CEO, head of product, head of engineering, etc., to deliver on the strategic business outcomes, including owning financial KPIs and human KPIs

DDD – Lead the Data Driven Decision (DDD) making across the entire organisation. Utilise business intelligence and performance metrics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.

Experience gamification for optimised engagement of stakeholders across all aspects of the XP

Kualifikasi

Education

A bachelor’s Degree in Business or Marketing, or any related discipline, is required.

Experience

Min.  10 years’ experience working ideally in business management, Strong Marketing & sales/business Development, customer service, industrial design, etc., in driving digital initiatives with some independent P&L responsibilities

Five or more years of progressive leadership experience in leading cross-functional teams and enterprise-wide programs, operating and influencing effectively across the organisation and within complex contexts

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Experience in consumer industries like fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer banking, digital insurance, FinTech, sharing economy, etc., is preferred

Knowledge/Skills

Deep understanding of people and their motivations and behaviours

Ability to develop short interaction levers to drive strategic behaviours through gamification, rewards and engagement

Extensive knowledge of digital marketing, analytics, growth hacking and CRM.

Business-savvy strategic thinking: Big picture orientation and conceptualisation of ideas, conceiving effective strategies to drive growth and revenue generation

Strong business acumen, including domain-specific knowledge of the manufacturing and resources companies and their business units

Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking and consulting skills.

Strong influence and negotiation skills

Ability to effectively drive people, process and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment

Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain digital technologies to business leaders and business concepts to technologists

Must be a passionate human being with strong idealism and vision for a brighter future for Indonesia

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

SawitPRO is a game-changer, improving the smallholders’ living standard and helping our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil through efficient land use.

Daftar Sekarang

title: Lead of FFB & B2B Commercial (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Lead of FFB & B2B Commercial (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead and drive SawitPRO's FFB (Fresh Fruit Bunch) crop commercial strategy, focusing on growth, market expansion, and strategic partnerships to support the acquisitions of FFB sources and funnel these sources into our partner mills.

Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial strategy that aligns SawitPRO's mission to enhance palm oil farming and business practices through increase in FFB growth in all stakeholders

Collaborate with product development and marketing teams to ensure product offerings meet market demands and customer needs.

Identify and pursue new business opportunities, markets, and partnerships to expand SawitPRO's footprint.

Own and develop the customer relationship for 3 distinct types of B2B customers of SawitPRO - Crude Palm Oil mills (CPO Mills), DO Agents/suppliers of CPO mills (suppliers), FFB Ramps and any other actors in the supply chain to help speed up acquisition and activation of the FFB sources.

Optimize and maximise revenue opportunities from the user base

Provide high quality customer experience through a combination of product, service and relationship management

Learn the motivation levels of each different types of customers, their pain points, business opportunities and growth prospects

Cross team collaboration across product, sales, operations, marketing and technology to promote good understanding of the customer

Be an ecosystem builder

Role of the Head, B2B Commercial

Strategy & ideation – The person responsible has to develop the overall strategy and ideas behind the company's FFB crop acquisition, conversion and customer management strategy

Team management – Lead a team of collaborators and contributors for delivering on all aspects of the business development and customer management

Leadership – demonstrate leadership by coming up with innovative ideas  as well as by building and managing a high performance team

Customer Management – Manage 3 distinct types of customers - Palm Oil mills, palm oil mill suppliers / agents, FFB Ramps and any other actors relevant to the FFB Crop Business

Customer Service - Focus on both customer acquisition and retention through a sound customer service approach

Execution KPIs – clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organization

Senior Management collaboration – work closely with senior management including the CEO, head of product, head of engineering, etc. to deliver on the strategic business outcomes including owning financial KPIs and human KPIs

DDD – Lead the Data Driven Decision (DDD) making across the entire organization. Utilize business intelligence and performance metrics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.

P & L - Manage revenue and costs generated from the customer base

CRM - Recommend, implement and own the Customer Relationship Management System for SawitPRO

Kualifikasi

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business or Marketing discipline is required.

Min.  10 years’ experience working in Sales, Commercial  business management, growth,, etc. in driving digital adoption among customers with independent P&L responsibilities

Five or more years of progressive leadership experience in leading cross-functional teams and enterprise wide programs, operating and influencing effectively across the organization and within complex contexts

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Experience in Sales of consumer industries like fast moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer banking, digital insurance, FinTech, sharing economy, etc. is preferred

Palm oil industry knowledge would be helpful (optional)

Deep understanding of people and their motivations and behaviours

Relationship building and management of different types of B2B customers

Strong business acumen, including domain-specific knowledge of the manufacturing and resources companies and their business units

Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking and consulting skills.

Strong influence and negotiation skills

Ability to effectively drive people, process and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment

Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain digital concepts and technologies to business leaders, as well as business concepts to technologists

Must be a passionate human being with strong idealism and vision for a brighter future of Indonesia

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills both internally with employees and externally with customers.

Experience with Cloud Technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP

Medan.
